implemented: Repository bootstrap: create a repository, commit through the contents API, list branches, read the file back
Issue triage: labels, issues, issue labels and comments, paginated issue lists, closing with a state reason
Pull request lifecycle: branch through git refs, commit, open, review (no self-approval), merge by merge, squash or rebase
CI status and checks: commit statuses and the combined status; check runs written by a GitHub App installation
GitHub App installation token: JWT claims checked, installation listed, ghs_ token minted and used
Release publish: create a release (tagging its target), fetch it by tag and as latest, upload assets
API version negotiation: GET /versions, 2026-03-10 served and echoed, every other version refused with 400
Workflow dispatch: workflows discovered from committed files; dispatch returns a run that is already completed
Webhook delivery: issues, pull_request, push and check_run (and ping), signed with X-Hub-Signature-256
not_implemented: GitHub Enterprise Server and Enterprise Cloud editions, enterprise administration
Search beyond the existing thin handlers
Webhook redelivery, and signature verification of App JWTs
Workflow execution: runs never progress over time
